name: OpenStreetMap
access: Downloaded .osm.pbf, converted to GeoPackage and loaded into PostGIS by etl/load_osm.py
updateFrequency: Geofabrik publishes daily; refreshed here by re-running the ETL
knownLimitations: Volunteer-mapped, so completeness varies a lot between places. Central Berovo, for example, has 171 mapped buildings where satellite-derived datasets find about 3,400. A missing feature does not mean it does not exist.
